items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: His name was Dr. -- I've forgotten his name -- Dr. somebody.

ctx.x: No. This was just a -- this man -- he would sell medicine and he'd have -- to my idea, I think he would have a lot of chicken entrails in a bottle, in alcohol or something like that, and he would tell them that

these are parasites that he got -- you take this medicine and we would get it out and one of those things and he was selling the medicine for a dollar a bottle. And then he would talk and talk and talk. His name was Dr. -- I've forgotten his name -- Dr. somebody. But, anyway, strike up the band. And we'd strike up the band and then he started to selling this medicine. Only going for a dollar a bottle. I don't think I have but a few left. And the people was crowded around this thing. And, you know, we would start…
